description: This file contains acceptance tests for the BasicModule in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM project, utilizing the Codeception testing framework. It defines a class with test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting records of the BasicModule, along with setup and teardown hooks.

classes.name: BasicModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the BasicModule, containing scenarios to test creation, viewing, editing, duplication, and deletion of module records.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Teardown method after each test (empty here, but available for cleanup).

methods.name: testScenarioCreateBasicModule
methods.description: Test creating and deploying a basic module through the UI.

methods.name: testScenarioViewBasicTestModule
methods.description: Test viewing a deployed basic module in the list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateRecord
methods.description: Test creating a record in the basic module, filling in fields with fake data.

methods.name: testScenarioViewRecordFromListView
methods.description: Test searching for and viewing a specific record from the list view.

methods.name: testScenarioEditRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test editing an existing record from the detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDuplicateRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test duplicating a record from the detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDeleteRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test deleting a record from the detail view.
